market_news.snippet: **media[1301987]**USHP (U.S. Home Price) is the first-of-its-kind liquid index product tracking U.S. home prices, backed by housing-related reserve assets, with USHPi (U.S. Home Price - Income) available as its income-bearing variantUSHP has received institutional commitments up to $100 million, anchored by the Galaxy Sharplink Onchain Yield Fund, Forward Industries (Nasdaq: FWDI) and othersUSHP will be issued by USHP Limited, a British Virgin Islands company and subsidiary of the USHP Foundation, a Cayman Islands foundation company, with Index Industries serving as technology and services providerUSHP will be made available only to eligible institutional and non-U.S. investors GEORGE TOWN, Cayman Islands, Nov. 11, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The USHP Foundation, a Cayman Islands foundation company, today announced the upcoming launch of USHP, the first tokenized liquid index product tracking U.S. home prices. USHP gives investors broad, diversified exposure to U.S. housing through a single financial instrument. USHP references the U.S. Home Price Index (USHP Index), Index Industries' new, daily-reported benchmark for U.S. home prices that aligns closely with longstanding housing indices. USHP is the first index-based financial product to be powered by Index Industries' tokenization technology and real estate and capital markets services.
market_news.snippet_ko: **media[1301987]**USHP(미국 주택 가격)는 미국 주택 가격을 추적하는 최초의 유동성 지수 상품으로, 주택 관련 준비 자산으로 뒷받침되며, 수익 창출형 상품인 USHPi(미국 주택 가격 - Income)는 수익 창출형 상품으로 제공됩니다. USHP는 Galaxy Sharplink Onchain Yield Fund, Forward Industries(나스닥: FWDI) 등을 주축으로 최대 1억 달러 규모의 기관 투자 약정을 확보했습니다. USHP는 영국령 버진아일랜드에 소재한 기업이자 USHP 재단의 자회사인 USHP Limited가 발행할 예정입니다.
